checkpoints.description: [1/1] Fix the live-page frame watchdog misfiring on stylized app titles

impact_assessment.why: the live page shows 'The app frame loaded but did not start' for the working orrery studio because the watchdog title check is case-sensitive (ORRERY vs Orrery) and orrery matches none of the hardcoded structural selectors
impact_assessment.benefits: the live page stops showing a false failure banner for orrery and any future app with stylized titles
impact_assessment.risks: contract: heuristic shared via live-core export; dependency: none; concurrency: single active task slot; state: no catalog or build changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first node tests, headless browser check past the 10s watchdog, 178-test suite

checkpoints.checklists: passed: unittest(178), node live/atlas/project/verify suites, headless watchdog check, sync check, kb

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Enforce the screen handshake for declared apps and serve the handshake studio build

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Reconcile every shots.json commit pointer with the served builds

impact_assessment.why: all seven non-orrery live apps recorded shots from commits predating their served builds; six frozen apps are pixel-identical (zero source diffs between shot and build commits) and palette's editor had changed under its workspace shot
impact_assessment.benefits: the screenshot catalog is honest: every shot pointer names the build the pixels depict, and palette's workspace shot shows the served editor
impact_assessment.risks: contract: shots.json commit semantics = depicted build, not capture commit; dependency: none; concurrency: single active task; state: only docs/live/shots.json and one PNG change
impact_assessment.mitigation: git source-diff proof for the six bumps, headless capture + brightness check for palette, 178-test suite, sync --check

checkpoints.checklists: passed: unittest(178), sync --check, pointer audit ALL FRESH, headless palette capture

checkpoints.description: Mark the ChatDuck card archived in the AegeanWorks catalogue after upstream repository archival.

impact_assessment.benefits: Catalogue metadata consistent with GitHub state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: archived flag in repositories.json and card markup; dependency: none; concurrency: catalogue quiet; state: no behavioural change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Suite + gates, UI rebind (surface files touched), commit, publish.
